legend-hungary-danube-bend-route.story: curated scenic road. Danube, castles, historic towns. 52 km from Budapest to Esztergom, about 57 min of riding. On the way it passes Szentendre and Visegrád. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Hungary Danube Bend Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Hungary Danube Bend Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
